summary: End-to-end backend testing for TonersCart Supabase migration. 36/36 pytest cases passing across health, customer/supplier/admin signup & auth, admin approval/reject flow, supplier listings (Original/Compatible enforcement + 403 for unapproved), public search/grouped/facets, orders lifecycle (create, status transitions, cancel, joined reads), admin stats, Claude chat, and auth role enforcement.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test / .example TLDs (reserved). Documented - signups only work with real-looking domains. Acceptable since Supabase also rejects some reserved TLDs.
Returns supplier_status='pending' even when no suppliers_pending row exists (defaults to 'pending'). Minor — no current UX impact since signup always creates the pending row.
Stock decrement is not atomic (read-then-write). Concurrent orders could oversell. Low risk at current scale; consider a Postgres RPC or row-level UPDATE ... RETURNING.

action_items: Consider switching stock decrement in POST /api/orders to an atomic Postgres operation to prevent oversell under concurrency.
Consider returning supplier_status='not_applied' when no suppliers_pending row exists to distinguish from real pending state.
Note for docs/test harnesses: Pydantic EmailStr blocks reserved TLDs like .test — use real domains for test fixtures.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~560 lines and still single-file; as endpoints grow, split into auth/listings/orders/admin modules.
get_user_from_token swallows all exceptions silently — add logging to aid future debugging.
No pagination on /api/listings/search (limit=200) and /api/admin/* lists. Fine for MVP, will need pagination with growth.
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject together — not a backend test issue, but FE cookie auth won't work if added later; tighten origins.
Orders stock decrement is a non-atomic read-then-write (line 377-395 of server.py) — risk of oversell under concurrency.
No DB index hints are enforced in code; schema file not reviewed here but ensure search_norm / city / brand are indexed.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@tonerscart.in / Admin@123. Approved supplier: supplier1@test.com / Test@123. Fresh accounts created per run with unique emails on @tonerscarttest.com.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates 3-4 fresh users (unique UUID-suffixed emails): 1 customer, 1 supplier-to-approve (gets approved + creates 1 listing for HP 88A + 2 orders), 1 supplier-to-reject, 1 supplier-pending (stays pending). All prefixed test.* on tonerscarttest.com — safe to leave or bulk-clean via Supabase dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_supabase_backend.py is idempotent (UUID-suffixed emails). Reuses existing supplier1@test.com as the approved supplier reference. Uses Supabase Auth REST (/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password) directly to get JWTs since there is no /api/auth/login. If suppliers table ever has no data, TestAuthMe::test_existing_approved_supplier_me will self-skip. Chat test requires live EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and ~8s latency.
